Role: Principal Product Manager, Commerce AI Platform
Location: In-Office or Remote
Level: Expert/Leader (IC6)

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree AND 10+ years in product, service, or program management or software development (or equivalent)

Preferred:
- Bachelor's AND 15+ years in product management or software development
- 6+ years taking a product to market (design, product-market fit, launch)
- 8+ years improving product metrics (growth, usage, churn)
- 5+ years in product catalogs, marketplaces, or commerce search (taxonomy, merchant feeds)
- Shipping and scaling externally consumed APIs or data platforms
- Defining quality metrics for data or AI systems (coverage, precision/recall, freshness, factuality)
- Technical fluency in data pipelines, ML matching, LLM grounding
- Leading large senior engineering teams as IC; influencing external partners

Responsibilities:
- Catalog APIs (product, Product Graph)
- Schemas and versioning
- Responsible AI, privacy, security, data rights
- Merchant controls and attribution
- PRDs and release criteria
- Go-to-market with partner and product marketing teams
